description:
Bike Overview

The Lectric XP™ 3.0 is your gateway to an elevated and powerful adventure! It takes our award-winning XP™ 2.0 design to the next level, providing our best ride to date. A quieter motor, increased torque, better brakes, longevity boosters, and added suspension are only a few of the many notable upgrades with this epic eBike design. Best of all, brand-new optimized gearing makes riding at higher speeds smoother than ever before! The XP™ 3.0 is also compatible with fan-favorite new accessory options including the Yepp Seat and a Passenger Package that can hold riders up to 150lbs.

Disclaimer: Must be 18 years of age or older to ride

Features
Motor
A new upgraded 1000W Peak Rear Hub Motor with 55nm of torque.
Battery Power
48V lithium ion battery with Long-Range and Standard options to power your ride for up to 45 or 65 miles respectively.
Suspension
50mm Front Suspension Fork
Speed
Class 1, 2, or 3 eBike with Pedal-Assist and Throttle abilities.
The Brand
Since the first Lectric eBikes release in 2019, our mission has been to create accessible and affordable electric bikes for the masses. With the support from an enthusiastic customer base, our team has been able to excel as one of the fastest growing eBike companies in the world. With each new eBike model, we aim to empower riders from coast to coast to explore with confidence, and have fun while they’re at it. Adventure starts here!
Specs
Pedal-Assist & Throttle
Five levels of pedal assist and a half-twist throttle delivers the speed and power to own the road as a Class 1, 2, or 3 ebike.*
Tires
Puncture-resistant Lectric 20” x 3” fat tires make for a smoother ride. Slime is installed to prevent flat tires- at no additonal cost.
Battery
Available with a Standard or Long-Range internal 48V lithium-ion battery to power your ride for up to 45 or 65 miles respectively.**
Weight
Total bike weight is 64lbs with the 7lb battery installed.
LCD Display
A backlit, heads-up LCD display provides trip and battery intelligence on the go. IP-65 rated electrical components ensure greater water and dust resistance.
Safety Lights
An integrated safety system, featuring a headlamp and taillight combination powered by the internal battery allows you to be seen.
Rear Rack
An integrated Rear Rack holds up to 150lbs.
Motor
An 500W hub-motor (1000W Peak) with 55nm of torque, coupled with a 20 amp controller, delivers power and speed quicker than ever before.
Freewheel
11-28 tooth freewheel to provide pedaling efficiency and an easier riding experience at higher speed, boosted by a 7-gear drivetrain.
Charging
An external charging port on the down tube provides riders with the option to charge the eBike without removing the battery. Meanwhile, interchangeable spare batteries can be removed and installed in seconds, doubling your range.
Saddle & Grips
New custom designed saddle and softer durometer ergonomic grips compliments a sportier look while adding comfort so you can ride longer.
Throttle
Twist throttle delivers pure power on demand.
Suspension Fork
Front oil suspension fork with 50mm of travel softens any ride.
Brakes
Ultimate stopping power with 180mm mechanical disc brakes offers peace of mind in wet or dry conditions. Also equipped with motor inhibitors.
Folding Capabilities
A foldable design guarantees your ride will fit into virtually any compact space
Passenger Mode
Passenger Mode limits max speed to 10mph to add an additional layer of safety when a passenger is on the bike.
